bio: Located directly opposite its parent establishment, Café Imperial, this restaurant boasts an elegant blend of modern and classical aesthetics. In a stylish and invitingly vibrant setting, a highly competent and well-organised team provides attentive service. To the rear of the dining space you can see the chefs crafting classic dishes in the open kitchen: braised beef with a creamy sauce and bread dumplings, or sautéed rabbit kidneys with mustard sauce – the extensive menu has something to offer every palate! Breakfast is also available, and the restaurant remains open continuously throughout the day....
